videos.title: Web Accessibility Perspectives - Compilation of 10 Topics/Videos
videos.why: Ten short real-life scenes showing how captions, contrast, keyboard use and clear layout help disabled people and everyone else.

videos.title: WWDC25: Principles of inclusive app design | Apple
videos.why: How understanding disability leads to better apps for everyone, through multiple ways to interact, customisation and the built-in accessibility features.

podcasts.why: The story of the small ramps at street corners, won by disability activists, and how a fix for some people ended up helping almost everyone.

podcasts.episode: #96 Designing for accessibility w/ Anna Cook
podcasts.why: An accessibility designer on why teams overlook it and how to build it into everyday design work from the start.

reads.title: Designing for Web Accessibility
reads.why: Ten design tips, from contrast and colour to labels and feedback, each linked to the WCAG rule behind it.

reads.title: Accessibility
reads.why: Apple's concrete rules for text size, contrast, hit targets and motion, useful even if you only build for the web.

reads.title: Microsoft Inclusive Design
reads.why: The principles behind Microsoft's inclusive design approach, with real product examples and the lived experiences of disabled people.
